headlines.title: Accenture spent years building in China; now it may cash out
headlines.summary: A stream of suitors and a Wall Street bank suggest the consulting giant’s math has changed.

headlines.title: Accenture and Google Launch Gemini AI Agent Programme for US Federal Agencies
headlines.summary: Accenture Federal Services, a subsidiary of Accenture (NYSE:ACN), and Google Public Sector (NASDAQ:GOOG) have announced a programme to help US federal agencies develop and deploy artificial intelligence agents using Google’s Gemini models. The initiative, known as Gemini launchpads, is designed to support government organisations in building AI applications that can connect with existing data systems and automate administrative and operational processes.

headlines.title: Accenture Expands Federal AI Push With Google's Gemini Agents, Months After OpenAI Partnership
headlines.summary: The companies are targeting government workflows with embedded AI engineers and pre-built agents, but have not disclosed contract values or named federal customers.

headlines.title: Accenture Federal Services and Google Public Sector Establish Gemini Launchpads to Power Purpose-Built Agents Across Federal Missions
headlines.summary: WASHINGTON, October 19, 2026--Accenture Federal Services, a subsidiary of Accenture (NYSE: ACN), and Google Public Sector today announced the deployment of Gemini launchpads, a new capability designed to help federal agencies move more quickly from agentic experimentation to mission execution at scale.

headlines.title: Global Customer Technical Support Service Market Report 2026-2030 | Accenture, IBM, TCS, and Infosys Accelerate AI and Cloud Support to Capture $68.19B by 2030
headlines.summary: Dublin, Oct. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- "Customer Technical Support Service Market Report 2026" has been added to ResearchAndMarkets.com's offering. The global customer technical support service market is experiencing strong growth as organizations expand digital operations, modernize IT environments, and prioritize reliable customer experiences. The market is projected to increase from $50.03 billion in 2025 to $53.13 billion in 2026, representing a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 6.2%.

description: Accenture plc provides strategy and consulting, industry X, song, and technology and operation services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers systems integration and application management; security; intelligent platform; infrastructure; software engineering; data, AI, cloud; and automation and global delivery services. The company also operates business processes for specific enterprise functions, including finance and accounting, sourcing and procurement, supply chain, marketing and sales, and human resources, as well as industry-specific services, such as platform trust and safety, banking, insurance, network and health services; and designs, manufactures, and assembles automation equipment, robotics, and other commercial hardware products. It serves communications, media, and technology; financial services; banking and capital markets, and insurance; health and public service; consumer goods, retail, travel services; industrial; life science; and chemicals, natural resources, energy, and utilities sectors. Accenture plc has collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to deliver transformative digital services to public sector, defense, and national security organizations. It has a collaboration with OpenAI to help enterprise clients unlock new levels of innovation and growth by bringing agentic AI systems; has a strategic collaboration with Microsoft and Avanade for the development of an agentic factory intelligence system; and INFRONEER Holdings Inc. and SAP Japan Co., Ltd. to develop a new financial data and insights platform. It also has strategic partnership with Netomi, Inc. to help enterprises reinvent customer experience using agentic AI systems. The company has a strategic alliance with ServiceNow for integrated risk management and third-party risk management solutions. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
